profile.headline: Software Developer II at Hudson Valley Credit Union
profile.summary: Software Developer with over 3 years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise web applications using ASP.NET Core, Razor, MVC, C#, and SQL. Experienced in building automation solutions with Python, optimizing business processes, and delivering data-driven solutions that improve operational efficiency. Collaborative developer with a strong focus on writing maintainable, high-quality software in Agile environments.

projects.title: Loan Prediction
projects.description:
- Performed Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) on a loan approval dataset, using Pandas, Seaborn, and Matplotlib for data visualization and understanding the underlying patterns.
- Preprocessed data by handling categorical variables and applying label encoding to prepare the dataset for machine learning models.
- Built machine learning models for predicting loan approval, likely using models from Scikit-learn such as Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, or Random Forests.
- Evaluated model performance using accuracy and other relevant metrics to assess the predictive capabilities of the models.

projects.title: Stock Market Prediction
projects.description:
- Developed and trained a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) to predict stock price movements using historical market data.
- Implemented data preprocessing, feature scaling, and time-series modeling techniques to improve prediction accuracy.
- Evaluated model performance using mean squared error (MSE) and optimized parameters for better generalization.
